dedupe_keys.name: raylı sistem dairesi baskanlıgı rail datasets

description: Raylı Sistem Dairesi Başkanlığı: rail datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Raylı Sistem Dairesi Başkanlığı. Coverage: Raylı Sistem Dairesi Başkanlığı. The listing groups 16 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about rail; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Rail Systems Eminönü-Alibeyköy Tram Line Information; Rail Systems Rumelihisarüstü-Aşiyan Funicular Line District Station Da; Rail Systems Kabataş-Mecidiyeköy-Mahmutbey Metro Line Information; RAIL SYSTEMS KIRAZLI-HALKALI METRO LINE STATION INFORMATION. Formats seen: XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
